description: This PHP file defines a controller class CreateDatabaseSavepointController within the Human Resource Management project. It handles HTTP requests to create a database savepoint, interacting with a backup service and returning the response as JSON.

classes.name: CreateDatabaseSavepointController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling requests to create a database savepoint.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to create a database savepoint, interacts with the backup service, and returns a JSON response with the count of tables included in the savepoint.
